Voxel art: every object built from visible small cubes, MagicaVoxel-style blocky geometry with crisp cube edges.
A voxel game scene based on this game design:
# Game design — RÖDBRÅ: Beneath the Bell

## Pitch

Winter, 1893. Monster hunter Liv Ravn returns to the isolated Scandinavian valley of Vargdal after every church bell rings simultaneously, despite their clappers having been removed. Nameless dead villagers rise from frozen ground. Liv searches for her missing sister Elin and discovers that Elin has been kept alive beneath the church as the human voice sealing an ancient root-bound entity called the Bell Mother. A browser-playable third-person dark-fantasy action slasher featuring responsive three-hit combos, charged heavy attacks, dodge invulnerability, directional parries, iron ward projectiles, checkpoints at iron prayer posts, Rend executions, four distinct enemy archetypes, two minibosses, and a 3-phase final boss fight beneath a colossal suspended cracked bronze bell, culminating in a poignant story choice and dawn endings.

## Core loop

- **Traverse & Explore:** Journey through four interconnected atmospheric zones (The Last Ring, Hushwood Approach, The Red Mill, Below the Bell) guided by blood-red ritual ribbons, lanterns, silhouettes, and distant bell tolls.
- **Combat & Stagger:** Engage thralls and guardians using responsive sword strikes (light 3-hit combo, charged heavy thrust, sprint and dodge slashes). Time directional parries to deflect agile strikes and create riposte openings.
- **Resource Management & Rend Executions:** Manage 3 rechargeable iron wards and checkpoint-refilled health vials. Land consecutiv

Depict the world and atmosphere as a single illustrated scene. Voxel art built from visible small cubes: MagicaVoxel-style blocky geometry with crisp cube edges on every object, rendered as a highly polished 3D scene with the craft of a Pixar-quality animated film, cinematic lighting that fits the scene, soft ambient occlusion, rich detail and expressive composition. Wordless illustration, no text, no title, no words, no letters, no logos, no UI.

assets.name: liv_ravn
assets.prompt: blonde female warrior in blue and silver armor
assets.description: A blonde female warrior in a blue-and-silver medieval dress and light armor, with long hair worn loose and straight. She wears a grey scale-mail chest piece over a blue tunic with silver shoulder guards and bracers, plus a long blue skirt with pale trim and red shoes. Her expression is calm and serious, giving her a regal, disciplined look.

assets.name: hollow_thrall
assets.prompt: blue undead humanoid in a ragged coat
assets.description: A blue-skinned zombie or undead humanoid wearing a ragged yellow-green hooded coat over a red patterned shirt. It has dark teal hair, pale eyes, and torn sleeves that reveal blue arms, with a grim, eerie look. The outfit is shabby and worn, with dangling coat strips and a rough stitched, patchy feel.

assets.name: antler_warden
assets.prompt: skeletal deer humanoid in a ragged coat
assets.description: A skeletal deer-like humanoid with large red antlers and a pale bone-white body. It wears a ragged olive-green, blood-speckled coat that hangs like a torn cape over its shoulders and back, leaving the ribcage exposed. The overall look is eerie and undead, with long thin limbs and a stripped-down, haunted forest spirit feel.

assets.name: butcher_boss
assets.prompt: bearded male artisan in a red leather apron
assets.description: A stocky male artisan with a full reddish-brown beard and a distinct yellow marking under his left eye. He wears a deep red leather apron with dark grey pockets over a patterned tan tunic featuring blue details and bright red sleeve bands. Dark grey boots and blue trousers complete his practical, workshop-ready appearance.

assets.name: elin_sister
assets.prompt: young woman in traditional folk dress
assets.description: A young woman in traditional folk dress with a white bonnet, black bodice, white puff sleeves, and a red-and-white embroidered skirt trimmed in blue and green floral patterns. She wears white patterned socks and brown shoes, with short brown hair and a calm, neutral expression. The overall look is festive, regional, and old-fashioned.

assets.name: bell_mother
assets.prompt: undead woman in a black cloak
assets.description: A pale undead woman with long black hair and a solemn, eerie expression, dressed in a tattered white wrap and bone-like belt accents. Her body is marked with red-brown stains and dark seams, and she wears a long black cloak that falls behind her like a shadow. The overall look is ghostly, ritualistic, and unsettling.
